page.layout: One column of running text, filling the page; a narrow strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page's edge and is not transcribed. Catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: reat, dicito non dissimulanter, sed candi-
de, si potes; Cuias es tu, Lutheranus ne, an
Calvinista, vel aliquod simile præter natu-
ram in religione, cultuque diuino mon-
strum? Sic enim dissidium hoc & consen-s-
us Græcorum obijcietur oculis. Alias cum
inter eos confusa sint omnia, & unus alium
impugnet, & injurijs lacessat, quid ipse sis,

l.i: nanque recens eorum tempore, & ignota fuit
non definite in eadem sententia sunt concordes,

main_text.l: sed in se ipsos diversi, ut inter eos sint Carlosta-
conscientia amplecti non possumus: nec eorum_,
qui se a Luthero segregarunt, successioni, aut

l.i: proh dolor! innumeras animas æterno exitio

page.notes: No marginal notes and no running head on this page. The thin strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page's edge and was left out. Small stains and a mark at the bottom left are not printed text. "Zwinglianam_," and "eorum_," end with a printed dash-like mark, kept as printed; the mark may be a continuation sign and is uncertain. The spellings "obijcietur" and "iniurijs" were kept with the printed i/j, and "iniurijs" was changed to "injurijs" by the consonant rule, which is uncertain.
